notes: Application-only image; SoftDevice S140 7.3.0 (FWID 0x0123) must already be flashed. Requires the Adafruit Feather UF2 bootloader.

versions.notes: Adafruit/Nordic DFU package. ST7789 240x240 SPI display (factory lcd_panel.cpp pinout), BLE advert name = MAC last 6 hex digits. Build env meshnology_w13_companion_radio_ble. Flash span 0x27000..0x95b7f, 107 pages, 428.0 KB application.
